title: Sparse spanning $k$-strong oriented subdigraphs in split digraphs
summary: Jackson and Thomassen conjectured that every $2k$-strong digraph admits a spanning $k$-strong oriented subdigraph [Ann. N. Y. Acad. Sci. 555 (1989) 402-412]. The conjecture holds for $k=1$ but other than some partial results that have been obtained for general $k$ in some special families of digraphs, including symmetric digraphs, the conjecture remains wide open in general. Even the existence of an integer $K$ such that every $K$-strong digraph has a 2-strong spanning oriented subdigraph is open.
